description: Turn an interview transcript into a structured debrief. Two modes - self mode (own interview, scored, with career-track judgement) and consultant mode (paid diagnosis for someone else, delivered as a Word report). Triggers on "面试复盘", "逐字稿", "面试录音", "帮我复盘", "这场面试怎么样", "帮我看看他面试有什么问题". Not for live interview coaching or writing answers before an interview happens.
